mapper.select: SELECT id,name FROM enterprises WHERE admin_user_id=#{userId}

SELECT b.box_id,b.display_name,a.rider_user_id,u.username AS rider_username,a.assigned_at FROM box_ownerships o JOIN boxes b ON b.box_id=o.box_id LEFT JOIN box_assignments a ON a.box_id=o.box_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=a.rider_user_id WHERE o.owner_type='ENTERPRISE' AND o.enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} ORDER BY b.box_id
SELECT box_id,owner_type,enterprise_id,owner_user_id FROM box_ownerships WHERE box_id=#{boxId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT box_id,rider_user_id,assigned_at FROM box_assignments WHERE box_id=#{boxId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT b.box_id,b.display_name,'OWNED' AS source,NULL AS enterprise_name FROM box_ownerships o JOIN boxes b ON b.box_id=o.box_id WHERE o.owner_type='PERSONAL' AND o.owner_user_id=#{userId} UNION ALL SELECT b.box_id,b.display_name,'ASSIGNED' AS source,e.name AS enterprise_name FROM box_assignments a JOIN box_ownerships o ON o.box_id=a.box_id AND o.owner_type='ENTERPRISE' JOIN boxes b ON b.box_id=a.box_id JOIN enterprises e ON e.id=o.enterprise_id WHERE a.rider_user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY box_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM box_ownerships o LEFT JOIN box_assignments a ON a.box_id=o.box_id WHERE o.box_id=#{boxId} AND ((o.owner_type='PERSONAL' AND o.owner_user_id=#{userId}) OR (o.owner_type='ENTERPRISE' AND a.rider_user_id=#{userId}))
